spec2def(imaadp32.acm imaadp32.acm.spec)

# imaadp32.acm is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/imaadp32_acm-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(imaadp32.acm_shims OBJECT imaadp32.c)
target_link_libraries(imaadp32.acm_shims PRIVATE wine libwinmm libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(imaadp32.acm_shims) # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro
add_cargo_module(imaadp32.acm imaadp32_acm-cargo imaadp32.acm
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS imaadp32.acm_shims psdk)
